description: Manually defined semantic equivalences used ONLY for the 'semantic class agreement' measure (manuscript Sec. 4.7). They are never applied to exact-match accuracy or to taxonomy compliance, and outputs are never relabelled.

equivalences.label: parking lot
equivalences.rationale: Descriptive synonym of the canonical WHU-RS19 category 'parking'.

explicitly_not_equivalent.label: overpass
explicitly_not_equivalent.rationale: Intelligible infrastructure concept, but not a WHU-RS19 label. In the viaduct test the agent rejected the reference class, which is a class-interpretation error, not a synonym (Sec. 5.3).
